events.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs to be done?
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — we still need a few volunteers to sort donated materials, a couple people to manage sign-ins, and someone to keep the supply list updated.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Mara: I can take the supply list and help sort materials too. If you want, I can also cover a sign-in shift.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’m glad you’re here. I’m getting the repair drive organized now, and I’d love your help with the next steps.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Leo: Sure — tell me what needs doing next, and I’ll help.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Rosa: Great — first I’m making the repair list and matching people to jobs. If you can help me check who needs what, we’ll be in good shape.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Noah: Oh—right, thanks for checking. I’m still a bit behind, but I’ll send over any other names if they come to me.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Rosa: Thanks, Noah — that helps a lot. If you think of any volunteers, just send them my way and I’ll add them to the list.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Noah: Sure thing — I’ll do that, and sorry if I’m a little slow to catch up. I’ll send you any names I remember.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Rosa: Thanks, Kira — we still need a few volunteers to sort donated materials, manage sign-ins, and keep the supply list updated.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Kira: Just to confirm, that’s still the same list of help needed, right?
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Rosa: Yes, that’s still the list — sorting donated materials, managing sign-ins, and keeping the supply list updated. If you’d like, I can assign you one of those now.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
events.speaker: world

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Rosa: Thanks, Jules — we’ve moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center. I’m matching folks to jobs now, so if you can help check who still needs what, that’d be a big help.
events.speaker: Rosa

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check who still needs what and spread the word about the Sunday move.
events.speaker: Jules

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Rosa: Thanks, Jules — that’s a huge help. If you hear back from anyone, send me their name and what they can take on.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Gus: Yep — Saturday morning at the community shed is the spot, and folks should drop repairs off there first. I can bring a few extra tools if that helps.
events.speaker: Gus

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Saturday at the front porch.

events.text: Rosa: Thanks, Gus — that’ll help a lot. Let’s keep it at the community center on Sunday, and I’ll make sure folks know to bring repairs there.
events.speaker: Rosa

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Gus: Sounds good, Rosa — I’ll let folks know it’s at the community center on Sunday, and I can bring a few extra tools too.
events.speaker: Gus

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive is still looking pretty good so far—folks have already dropped off some tools and a few supplies. If you hear of any extras, send them my way and I’ll add them to the pile.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Rosa: That’s great to hear, Tess — thank you. I’ll keep an eye out for any extras and send them your way.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Tess: Thanks, Rosa — I really appreciate it. I’m still keeping tabs on the turnout and the donations as they come in.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. If you can take the supply list and help sort materials, that would be a big help.
events.speaker: Rosa

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can handle the supply list and help sort materials, and I can cover a sign-in shift too if you still need it.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Mara — thank you. I’ll put you on the supply list, materials sorting, and one sign-in shift.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa — I’m still waiting on the final time for the repair drive, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I have it.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — it’s set for Sunday at the community center. If you can share that final time once you get it, I’d really appreciate it.
events.speaker: Rosa

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Uli: Absolutely — I’ll let you know as soon as I have the exact time. Thanks for your patience, Rosa.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Jules: I’ve heard back from Hana and Leo — Hana can bring a toolbox and look for tape and screws, and Leo can bring the tools by 10. Send me anyone else who’s available and what they can take on.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Rosa: Perfect, thanks Jules — please keep sending names and what they can cover, and I’ll slot them in. I’ll check if anyone else can help with setup and supplies too.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Jules: Will do — I’ll keep an eye out for anyone who can help with setup or supplies and send you their names and what they can cover.
events.speaker: Jules
